# Phase 2B consolidated task-read inventory

Audit date: 2026-10-17. This appendix accompanies [the audit](task-read-architecture-audit.md). Paths below are relative to the plugin unless prefixed with `System/` or `ItacanTaskCore/`. Line references were checked against current source. This inventories production entry points and material indirect reads, including retained writers; test fixtures are evidence, not production consumers.

Classification: **A** intentional writer dependency; **B** authoritative non-task source; **C** explicit legacy compatibility/read boundary; **D** overlooked task display; **E** avoidable repeated enumeration; **F** unresolved authority. Migrated consumers are marked **facade**, with their remaining legacy conversions marked C. No active D or unresolved F was identified in the inspected production graph. E describes a cost, not a second authority.

## Dormant and negative-search results

The sync copies `main-DESKTOP-70KBT1F.js`, `main-DESKTOP-70KBT1F-2.js`, and dashboard `view-DESKTOP-70KBT1F.js` files contain old direct readers. The inspected canonical entry points/build and renderer references do not load them; classify as dormant legacy artifacts, not active D. Removing them is outside this audit. Static reference search cannot establish every possible external plugin/manual script.

Search covered the canonical plugin entry, all production service/domain/UI modules and dashboard scripts, not just Phase 2B edits. Raw task enumeration remaining outside the adapter is the intentional Oath writer path; source parsing remains in writers, action bridges and overlays. Quick Add, Inbox, context menus, recurrence, source navigation, saved Daily Brief, Schedule, Phase editor, Progress, presets/restoration and background notifications were traced as above.
